clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope

clauses.title: Requirements for plain end
clauses.text: 1.1 Requirements for plain end as well as socket end pipes including those for use with electronic sealing rings.

clauses.title: This standard does not cover
clauses.text: 1.2 This standard does not cover  unplasticized PVC pipes  use in suction and delivery lines of agricultural pumps.

clauses.title: The pipes covered in
clauses.text: 1.3 The pipes covered in this standard are not suitable for use as casing pipes in tubewells.

clauses.title: Classification
clauses.text: 2. Classification— Shall be classified  by pressure ratings (working pressure at 270C . Class of Pipe Working Pressure (PN) Class 1 0.25 MPa (2.5kg/cm2) Class 2 0.4   MPa (4.0  kg/cm2) Class 3 0.6   MPa (6.0  kg/cm2) Class 4 0.8   MPa (8.0  kg/cm2) Class 5 1.0   MPa (10.0  kg/cm2) Class 6 1.25 MPa (12.5kg/cm2) Note—  The above pipes are recommended for water temperature ranging from + 1 to 450C, The recommended maximum safe working stress for these pipes is 8.6 MPa at 270C. At higher temperature upto 450C  the strength of pipes reduce and working pressure shall be modified in accordance with fig1 of the standard.

clauses.title: Composition–Material
clauses.text: 3. Composition-Material shall consist substantially of unplasticized polyvinyl chloride to which maybe added additives that are needed to facilitate the manufacture of pipe and production of sound and durable pipe of good surface finish mechanical strength and opacity. The monomer consent (VCM) in the resin shall be within the links of IS 10151:1982*

clauses.title: Physical and Chemical
clauses.text: 5. Physical and Chemical  Characteristics

clauses.title: Visual Appearance
clauses.text: 5.1 Visual Appearance: The colour of pipes shall be light grey. The internal and external surfaces of the pipes shall be smooth clean and free from grooving and other defects.

clauses.title: Opacity – Wall of
clauses.text: 5.2 Opacity - Wall of the plain pipe shall not transit more than 0.2 percent of the visible light falling on it. +   Polyvinyl chloride (PVC) and  its copoplymers for  use in contact with    food  stuffs, pharmaceuticals and drinking  water

clauses.title: Effect on Water
clauses.text: 5.3 Effect on Water — Pipes shall not have any detrimental effect on composition of water flowing through them. When tested toxic substances extracted from internal walls of the pipes shall not exceed the concentrations in the test solution as given in 10.3 of the standard.

clauses.title: Reversion Test
clauses.text: 5.4 Reversion Test — A length of pipe 200±20 mm long shall not alter in length by more than 5 percent.

clauses.title: Vicat Softening Temperature
clauses.text: 5.5 Vicat Softening Temperature —Shall not be less than 800C.

clauses.title: Density
clauses.text: 5.6 Density—Shall be between 1.40 and 1.46 g/cm3

clauses.title: Sulphated Ash content
clauses.text: 5.7 Sulphated Ash content— Shall not exceed 11 percent.

clauses.title: Mechanical
clauses.text: 6. Mechanical  properties

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Characteristics
clauses.text: 6.1 Hydrostatic Characteristics—Shall not fail during the prescibed test duration.

clauses.title: Resistance to external blows
clauses.text: 6.2 Resistance to external blows at 00C shall have a true impact rate of not more than 10 percent. Note — For methods of measurements and tests, refer to IS 6307 : 1987 Rigid PVC sheets (first revision) relevant parts of IS 12235 : 1986. Methods of test for unplasticized PVC pipes for potable water supplies, IS1 3360 (Part 3/ sec 1): 1995 Plastics Methods of testing, Part 3  Physical and dimensional properties, Section 1 Determination of density and relative density of noncellular plastics For detailed information, refer to IS 4985 : 2000  Specification for  unplasticised PVC pipes for potable water supplies (third revision).
